healthCheckStatus.mitigation: expertQuery default changed to a self-refreshing 'publication-date >= today(-14) AND classification-cpv = 72*' window (TED's server-side today([+-]N) function, live-verified), reducing matched notices from 42,134 to 2,332
healthCheckStatus.rootCause: Apify Cloud network-path latency to api.ted.europa.eu, not actor code or TED server performance
healthCheckStatus.guaranteeCaveat: Reduces but does not guarantee sub-300s completion; a single retried fetch() attempt has been observed taking 60-150+ seconds and tedClient.ts has no per-attempt timeout

testCoverage.note: DISCLOSED GAP: unlike its 3 fleet siblings (77/112/135 passing tests respectively), this actor currently has zero automated test files. The included .github/workflows/deploy.yml's 'npm test' step will fail in CI until test coverage is added. This is a known, disclosed limitation, not an oversight or a silently-patched-around gap.

knownRisks: No per-attempt HTTP timeout in src/tedClient.ts (identified, not implemented — a candidate future hardening)
